description: HOLLAND, MI – The FBI released new data that shows crime is soaring across MI-04 with Kalamazoo and Battle Creek now ranking among the worst cities for violent crime anywhere in America. Congressman Bill Huizenga’s campaign released the following statement: “Michigan families desperate for safer streets won’t find help from radicals like ’Tax Man’ Sean McCann or his buddy Abdul El-Sayed,” said Huizenga…
